end.parentNote: Asha practised the categories through concrete examples and an if-then test format. Tara explained why one statement was an observation and another was a hypothesis, and gave the scientific meaning of theory. There was a mix-up between boiling faster and boiling at a higher temperature; this was corrected later. At home, ask Tara to label everyday science statements as observation, hypothesis, law, or theory and explain the choice in one sentence.
